definitionName: Nightwatch documentation roles, current-truth bounds and relocation records
note: Every top-level docs/*.md file has exactly one role. CURRENT_TRUTH documents are bounded and must stay readable end to end; APPEND_ONLY_ARCHIVE documents keep the historical record and existing lines may not be modified or deleted, only appended to; OPERATOR_REFERENCE documents are instructions an operator follows at a specific point. hardening:check fails on an undeclared, duplicate-declared or missing file, on a CURRENT_TRUTH document over its declared maximum, and on an archive modification that no declared correction covers. A relocation moves text from a CURRENT_TRUTH document into an APPEND_ONLY_ARCHIVE byte-identically; the recorded digest is the digest of the moved bytes, so editing an archived relocation after the fact fails the correspondence check.

relocations.summary: The master plan's review-time §2 'Repository and system overview' (inventory and method, major boundaries and flows, evidence and limits at review close) moved byte-identically into the architecture archive to keep the current-truth plan under its declared bound.
